summary: When David was old, he chose Solomon to be the next king. Solomon was anointed with oil, the trumpet blew, and the people shouted, 'Long live King Solomon!' David told Solomon to walk in God's ways.

story_reel.narration: King David grew very old. Before he died, he made sure the next king would be the one God had chosen: his son Solomon. David said, 'Put Solomon on my own mule, and take him down to the Gihon Spring. Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. Then blow the trumpet and shout, Long live King Solomon!' So that's exactly what they did. Zadok took the horn of oil from the Tabernacle and poured it on Solomon's head. They blew the trumpet, and all the people shouted, 'Long live King Solomon!' Then everyone followed Solomon, playing flutes and celebrating so loudly that the ground shook with the sound! Later, when David was about to die, he called Solomon to his side and gave him his last advice. 'I'm going the way of all the earth. Be strong, and show yourself a man. Keep the charge of Yahweh your God. Walk in His ways and keep His commandments, as it is written in the Law of Moses. Then you will prosper in everything you do and wherever you go.' Then David died and was buried in the City of David. Now young Solomon was king. He had big shoes to fill, and he knew he needed help.

scenes.caption: On David's mule

scenes.art_direction: A trumpet blast and a huge cheering crowd.

scenes.caption: A father's last words
scenes.art_direction: David holding Solomon's hand, speaking softly as candlelight glows.

memory_verse.text: know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind

identity_focus.core_truth: I can choose to know Yahweh for myself and walk in His ways.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: David told Solomon to walk in God's ways. What advice about God has someone in your family given you?

quiz.question: Where was Solomon anointed king?
quiz.explanation: They brought Solomon down to Gihon, and Zadok the priest anointed him.

quiz.question: What did the people shout?
quiz.explanation: All the people said, 'Long live King Solomon!'

quiz.question: What did David tell Solomon before he died?
options: Walk in God's ways and keep His commandments
quiz.explanation: David said, 'Keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, I want to know You for myself, not just hear about You. Help me walk in Your ways and serve You with my whole heart and a willing mind. Amen.

companion.message: When I heard the crowds shouting my name, the ground literally shook! But my father's last words stayed with me most: 'Walk in God's ways.'

review.notes: Omits Adonijah's attempt to take the throne (1 Kings 1:5-27) and David's instructions about Joab and Shimei (2:5-9). Confirm.
